note: Where the engine's output is meant to land. Data, not code: model ids and harness surfaces change on someone else's schedule, so they are declared here instead of compiled into the engine. `available:false` lists a harness that is known but not wired yet — a listed-and-off harness informs, an invented one lies. The UI reads this to show the Regent, before anything is emitted, which file will be written and with what header.
